verses.text: Jesus called his twelve followers to him. He gave them authority to drive out evil spirits and to heal every kind of disease and illness.
These are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon, who is called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who later handed Jesus over to his enemies.
Jesus sent out these twelve with these instructions: "Do not go to the people who are not Jews, and do not go into any town of the Samaritans.
Instead, go to the people of Israel, who are like lost sheep.
As you go, preach this message: 'The kingdom of heaven is near.'
Heal the sick, make people with skin diseases clean, and drive out demons. You received freely, so give freely.
Do not take any gold, silver or copper money in your belts.
Do not take a bag for the journey, or a spare shirt, or sandals, or a walking stick. Workers deserve to be given their food.
"Whatever town or village you go into, look for someone who is worthy and stay at their house until you leave.
As you go into the home, greet the family.
If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it. If it is not worthy, let your peace come back to you.
If anyone will not welcome you or listen to your words, shake the dust off your feet as you leave that home or town.
I tell you for certain, it will be easier for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgement than for that town.
"I am sending you out like sheep among wolves. So be as wise as snakes and as harmless as doves.
Be careful of people. They will hand you over to the courts and whip you in their synagogues.
Because of me you will be brought in front of governors and kings. You will tell them and the other nations about me.
But when they arrest you, do not worry about what to say or how to say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.
It will not really be you speaking. The Spirit of your Father will be speaking through you.
"Brothers will hand each other over to be killed, and fathers will hand over their children. Children will turn against their parents and have them put to death.
Everyone will hate you because of me. But whoever keeps going until the end will be saved.
When people treat you badly in one town, escape to the next. I tell you for certain, you will not finish going through the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
"A student is not greater than his teacher, and a servant is not greater than his master.
It is enough for the student to be like his teacher, and the servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, the members of his family will be called even worse names!
"So do not be afraid of them. Everything that is covered up will be uncovered, and every secret will be made known.
What I tell you in the dark, say in the daylight. What is whispered in your ear, shout from the rooftops.
Do not be afraid of people who can kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, be afraid of God, who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
Are two sparrows not sold for a small coin? Yet not one of them falls to the ground without your Father knowing.
Even the hairs on your head have all been counted.
So do not be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows.
"Whoever says in front of others that they belong to me, I will say in front of my Father in heaven that they belong to me.
But whoever says in front of others that they do not know me, I will say in front of my Father in heaven that I do not know them.
"Do not think that I came to bring peace to the earth. I did not come to bring peace, but a sword.
I have come to turn a son against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
A person's enemies will be the members of their own family.
"Anyone who loves their father or mother more than me is not worthy of me. Anyone who loves their son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
Anyone who does not pick up their cross and follow me is not worthy of me.
Whoever tries to keep their life will lose it, and whoever gives up their life for me will find it.
"Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.
Anyone who welcomes a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet's reward. And anyone who welcomes a good person because they are good will receive a good person's reward.
And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because they are my follower, I tell you for certain, that person will never lose their reward."
